procedure.method: Fresh independent session with no spawn, fork, resume or peer-review access. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rubric, review rules and compact method. Verified byte counts and SHA-256 pins. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty, so zero source opens and zero protected-layout reads apply; read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing without following their embedded paths. Actually opened and visually inspected each of the 15 exact PNGs sequentially via tools.view_image with detail original and emitted the returned image to this session: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All 15 initial poster views preceded the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment and score. Retained first raw readings for all 55 copy entries. One genuine M4 title word-spacing ambiguity triggered one additional open of its exact pinned native view; both readings are retained and the ambiguity remains unresolved. Total actual poster image opens: 16, comprising the ordered 15 plus that one revisit. No sources or replacement assets were opened, no crops or images were generated or edited, and no session identity or serialized opening event was invented. Read-only PNG inspection confirmed RGB opacity and dimensions. Native 1672x941 is rounded rather than mathematically exact 16:9: abs(941-1672*9/16)=0.5, within the predeclared single-edge tolerance; usage720 is 720x405 and thumbnail320 is 320x180.

content_form.observation: The scene and nearby subtitle identify one exhibition/talk event, while the practical copy is grouped into visible participation information.

hierarchy.location: top-left date/time versus top-right Korean title
hierarchy.observation: The huge white date/time and very large dark title form two competing headline areas. Starting on the left foregrounds scheduling before the event identity, while the English label and descriptor form another dense stack at right.

The title, date and time remain conspicuous but compete at almost equal visual intensity; the guide/gallery scene reads as an inserted rectangle between title and footer rather than resolving that rivalry.

typography.location: left date, venue and logistics blocks
typography.observation: Nearly every information level uses a heavy sans-serif treatment; the very large date/time and large venue are followed by similarly heavy admission/free/application lines. The size steps give legibility but little optical or tonal refinement across roles.

typography.location: right title and bottom invitation lines
typography.observation: The title is massive, the English/subtitle stack is bold, and the invitation is also bold. Glyphs are readable, but the repeated weight makes a blunt notice rather than a finely differentiated typographic system.

space.location: left column between time and venue, versus right photo and footer
space.observation: A large empty interval follows the time in the left column, whereas the right column is tightly packed with title, label, descriptor, photograph and footer. The uneven density makes the composition feel split into separately filled blocks.

The image is hard-aligned to the teal/yellow seam, but the left practical groups have no comparable cross-column horizontal relationship to the photograph or footer; the empty space does little to unite the reading sequence.

image_material.location: gallery walls, frames, windows and figures
image_material.observation: The rectangular frames, timber floor, glazing, soft fabric and sunlight form a coherent photographic scene with credible local material differences. The people are distinct enough to communicate a guided visit.
The activity and the architecture imagery survive downsampling; neither scene identity nor the relation between listener group and speaker disappears.

emotion_control.location: gallery visitors and warm window light
emotion_control.observation: Ordinary adult clothing, a small listening group and warm interior light communicate an accessible visit rather than a grand institutional campaign.
The bright panels and explicit invitation produce an open, practical community tone; the reassurance remains visible and supports first-time attendance.

ai_slop.location: right-hand gallery scene and left information field
ai_slop.observation: The framed images, attendees and guide are related to the event rather than arbitrary decorative additions. No disconnected object, pseudo-print, extra logo or obvious fused major form is visible at this inspection scale.
The blocks have clear content roles and the image's figures remain coherent; the observed shortcomings are coarse hierarchy/spacing rather than a claim about the production medium.

residuals: Competing date/time and title towers weaken the first reading.
Uniform heavy typography and uneven density between the two columns remain at a functional, generic notice level.
The gallery scene is coherent and supports the event, but no source identity or protected geometry was supplied to compare.

space.location: central window opening and text on side walls

image_material.location: window reveal, floor, chairs and framed pictures

The image retains its depth and architectural legibility after reduction, with clean chair silhouettes and a clearly bounded window aperture.

emotion_control.observation: The quiet warm room and ordinary chairs communicate attentive observation and an accessible small gathering. The image avoids a monumental landmark or institutional sales mood.
The invitation and reassurance are readable within the inhabited-looking room, giving the otherwise quiet image a welcoming community purpose.

The chair frames remain distinguishable and their long shadows relate to the window light; there is no observed major fused-object defect that would undermine the scene.

residuals: The smallest supporting lines become minute at thumbnail320; they remain readable at the required usage720 size.
The talk is suggested by the chairs and supplied descriptor rather than shown as an active guided group; the architecture/light relationship is stronger than the social narrative.

typography.location: left English/subtitle stack and right guidance stack
typography.observation: All letters are readable, but the stacked bold lines produce a generic information-sheet treatment. The long title and the oversized date are both packed close to the widths of their respective columns.

space.observation: The hero image and date begin on a common upper line; the left title/descriptor aligns with the photograph's left edge, and the inset plus venue/entry create a coherent middle-right row.
Consistent left alignment and open vertical intervals separate free/application from visit/reassurance. The remaining background provides clear breathing room around the detail image and information.

image_material.observation: Wall thickness, sill, floor tiles and the triangular wall light create coherent architectural depth; foliage outside and its floor shadow remain distinguishable from the mineral surfaces.
The crop shows glazing, a stone sill and wall texture with clean local transitions. The material expression is coherent with the main image and remains legible at usage720.

emotion_control.location: pale-blue field, orange title and bright interior
emotion_control.observation: The cool field and warm title/image light produce a clear, sunny invitation appropriate to observing ordinary architecture. The effect is approachable and avoids a grand institutional identity.
The practical invitation and reassurance are readable and keep the photostudy arrangement accessible to residents who are new to architecture.

ai_slop.location: window, wall planes and floor in both photos
ai_slop.observation: The pictured elements relate directly to architectural light and material observation; no arbitrary icon, pseudo-print, added brand or major contradictory object is visible.

Image panels and information groups have intelligible roles. The weak content specificity and repeated typography are observed design limitations, while the local image construction itself remains clean.

residuals: The photo-plus-detail treatment remains generic; the exhibition/talk activity is carried largely by the subtitle.
Title, schedule and hero image compete, and the typography repeats the heavy information-block system of other members.
The local image construction and spatial grid are coherent, but the complete visual direction is insufficiently distinct within the set.

The other ten supplied entries were read once in packet order and are readable at usage720; the two-line shoe instruction is a soft layout wrap.

revisit.resolution: The four lower-line glyphs remain readable, but the gap between 는 and 집 is not clearly distinguishable from the neighboring interglyph gaps. Meaningful word-space preservation remains unresolved. No missing Hangul glyph is inferred.

evidence.observation: A seated speaker addresses an adult group before four architecture pictures in a daylit room. The cutaway makes both exhibiting and listening visible in a single space and gives the event a clear, approachable community context.

evidence.observation: Practical date/time, venue, entry, free viewing/explanation, application/capacity and visit/reassurance lines are readable. The Korean title's lower-line word separation remains ambiguous; all glyphs are visible. No added logo, QR, watermark or extra legible copy is visible.

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.
Architecture/light observation and the photo-exhibition plus space-talk event must connect coherently, with an approachable adult community-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720. No identifiable real building/institution promotion.

evidence.location: large central room illustration
evidence.observation: Walls, window, door, chairs, people, bookshelves, plants, framed architectural photographs and light form a substantial explanatory spatial illustration. It is neither lettering alone nor a tiny icon/texture.

evidence.location: central seated group and speaker under displayed pictures
evidence.observation: The audience/speaker relation and photographed architecture remain legible at use size; the cutaway visual directly communicates participation in the requested exhibition/talk.

content_form.location: cutaway exhibition room and seated group
content_form.observation: The speaker, listening adults and architectural pictures make the photo exhibition and space talk one concrete gathering. The window, wall surfaces and light extend the architectural observation subject.
The image explains what attendance entails while the two text columns clearly provide the event identity, schedule and participation information.

hierarchy.location: large upper-left title, central room and right information column
hierarchy.observation: The title is the primary text anchor and the room becomes the visual focus; horizontal rules separate descriptor/schedule on the left and venue/participation/guidance on the right.
The central social scene remains distinct from the compact side columns, giving a clear image-versus-information relationship even when small.

typography.location: lower Korean title line at upper left
typography.observation: The spacing after 는 does not clearly distinguish the word break before 집 from ordinary interglyph gaps. Both retained readings show all glyphs, but this optical treatment prevents confident certification of the meaningful word space.

The condensed heavy title remains readable as glyphs but densely joined; the shoe guidance wraps into two bold lines while nearby reassurance stays in one. The support type is legible, yet this member lacks consistently refined word-space and line treatment.

space.location: left descriptor line adjacent to central wall edge
space.observation: The long event descriptor fills almost the entire narrow left column and approaches the illustration, while the large scene occupies nearly the full canvas height. This creates a tight copy/image boundary rather than a generous consistent gutter.

Both side columns use long lines close to their available widths; the shoe guidance must wrap while the adjacent blocks remain single-line. The flanking layout is understandable, but dense copy beside the oversized scene leaves uneven breathing room.

image_material.location: room walls, glazing, seating and four framed images
image_material.observation: Linework and softly shaded surfaces coherently describe an elevated cutaway. Distinct chairs, adult figures and architecture pictures are intelligible, with window light and foliage anchoring the room.

The simplified drawn figures retain their social roles, and the cutaway door/window geometry is readable after reduction. The illustration is materially consistent rather than dependent on microscopic detail.

emotion_control.location: small seated audience and gesturing speaker
emotion_control.observation: The scale of the group, ordinary seating and modest furnishings communicates a friendly explanatory session that an adult resident could join.

emotion_control.location: warm terracotta wall edges and off-white field
emotion_control.observation: The warm room and light background support an approachable instructional mood; the reassurance copy is visually connected to the scene of listening adults.

ai_slop.observation: Furniture, plants, books and pictures serve the plausible exhibition/talk setting rather than accumulating unrelated symbols. The main people/chair/wall forms remain separated and readable.

The illustrative simplification is consistent across the room and figures, and the rules organize actual information. No observed major fused form, pseudo-label or arbitrary decoration undermines the event.

Dense narrow side columns and the near full-height central scene leave uneven gutters and breathing room.
The cutaway strongly connects exhibition and talk, but the heavy sans-serif treatment still overlaps other members' typographic systems.

evidence.location: lower two-fifths window and projected-light construction
evidence.observation: Repeated window frames, recesses and broad light polygons occupy a substantial band. They communicate architectural openings and the path of light; they are not glyphs, tiny ornaments or background texture.

evidence.location: lower navy/yellow image band
evidence.observation: The deep frames and light shapes remain legible and have a major compositional role, supplying the architecture/light subject at the intended viewing width.

content_form.observation: The band communicates architecture and projected light effectively, but the repetitive aperture motif is a generic light/space symbol. It does not develop a visual relationship to photographic exhibition or shared space explanation beyond the supplied descriptor.

content_form.location: upper text field versus lower visual band
content_form.observation: The text is a complete event notice, while the image functions as an independent decorative subject strip; the specific exhibition/talk content is not developed through interaction between those roles.

hierarchy.observation: Both title and schedule are huge heavy anchors. The English/descriptor and participation stacks sit below them in equally bold text, yielding two competing notice columns rather than a strongly staged reading sequence.

hierarchy.location: whole upper text field and lower strip
hierarchy.observation: The title, schedule and bright band all assert themselves; the practical groups are legible at use size but the small view reinforces the coarse equal-weight blocks.

typography.observation: The title, OPEN HOUSE, descriptor, date/time, venue and invitation all use a very heavy sans-serif voice. Size is the principal differentiator, so the large amount of copy has little tonal refinement between event identity, logistics and reassurance.
Glyphs and punctuation remain readable, but the repeated heavy stacks and tightly filled title/date widths give a generic notice treatment very close to M1 and M3.

space.location: upper cream field divided into two columns above navy band
space.observation: A consistent left/right text division and full-width lower band give the composition deliberate proportions. The major groups align cleanly and the strip begins on a clear horizontal boundary.

space.location: free/application left and visit/reassurance right above the band
space.observation: The two lower text groups are balanced across the field with clear vertical separation from venue/entry and English/descriptor above. The spaces keep all practical lines independently readable.

image_material.location: window frames and yellow light polygons
image_material.observation: Flat navy/yellow fields and white recess faces form a coherent graphic architectural language; increasing aperture scale and broad floor-light shapes make a recognizable spatial rhythm.
The frame edges and projected-light silhouettes stay crisp and unambiguous at use size. The graphic material is consistent and does not rely on photorealism to work.

emotion_control.location: high-contrast repeated apertures in lower band
emotion_control.observation: The fluorescent yellow and navy produce energetic visual impact appropriate to light as a subject, but the impersonal repeated windows communicate a broad modern promotion more than a specific welcoming neighborhood gathering.

The invitation is readable, yet it uses the same heavy notice voice as the logistics and remains separate from the empty graphic scene. The social reassurance is chiefly verbal rather than a refined visual emotional relation.

ai_slop.observation: The repetition is tied to windows and light rather than an unrelated generated ornament. The major aperture/recess/light silhouettes remain clean; no pseudo-print or obvious malformed primary shape is visible.

ai_slop.location: entire text field and graphic band
ai_slop.observation: The bounded strip and copy groups have consistent roles. The motif is generic, but there is no evidence of a major unresolved artifact requiring a medium-based penalty.

residuals: The architecture/light motif is legible but generic; the exhibition/talk and welcoming group experience are carried mostly by copy.
Large competing title/date blocks and uniform heavy typography remain at a functional notice level.
The lower graphic strip changes the image expression, but the upper information system remains closely related to M1 and M3.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: teal left information column and yellow right title/photo panel
evidence.observation: A two-column notice with very large date/time competing against a heavy Korean title and a documentary gallery photograph. M3 mirrors the broad image/information division, and M5 repeats the heavy title/date pairing; the palette change is stronger than the change in typographic system.

evidence.location: full-frame interior with title at lower left and information at right
evidence.observation: The full-bleed room makes architectural space the entire field; the lighter white supporting type inhabits the walls and the large lower-left title anchors the floor. This changes image/type roles meaningfully from M1 and M3, rather than merely recoloring a boxed photograph.

evidence.location: large photo at upper left, orange title below, right date and detail inset
evidence.observation: The photo-study arrangement adds a window detail, swaps the information side relative to M1 and moves the title underneath the hero. Nevertheless its image panels, large bold date, stacked heavy sans-serif logistics and title-plus-English-plus-subtitle stack remain close to M1's notice system; its sunny window imagery also overlaps M2.

evidence.location: central cutaway room and two flanking text columns
evidence.observation: The elevated cutaway scene explains seating, a speaker and displayed photographs; horizontal rules organize the flanking text. This is a meaningful explanatory composition with a different viewpoint and social narrative from M2's immersive room, although the title and logistics retain the same heavy sans-serif family seen elsewhere.

evidence.location: upper two-column text field and lower window/light band
evidence.observation: The image becomes a continuous graphic strip instead of a photographed scene, creating a distinct rhythmic impression. The upper field still repeats M1/M3's large heavy title/date rivalry and rectangular stacks of similarly weighted logistics. The five arrangements vary, but the shared typographic/information system leaves fewer than five fully distinct directions.

residuals: Full-set diversity remains 3; the image expressions vary more decisively than the typography and information structures.
M4's lower title line has unresolved meaningful word-spacing ambiguity after one native revisit; this review cannot certify its exact copy.
These are one critic's observations of the selected five pinned posters. No peer scores, aggregate three-critic gate, unseen requests or producer intent were assessed.
